title: FRENCH STYLE OAK HALL STAND H-...
reason: Substantial French provincial style oak hall stand with mirror, carved panels and iron hooks; decorative furniture that could be worth real money if sound.
findings: French provincial style hall stand in golden-brown oak (per title): shaped crest with carved rosette, central mirror panel with a carved floral and rosette panel below, side panels of carved concentric circles and leaf sprays, bobbin-turned spindle side panels, about six hand-forged iron coat hooks, a serpentine-top drawer with a brass-coloured knob lined with yellow small-motif printed cotton, an open shelf below, and bobbin-turned columns on a bowed base with bun feet. Looks like a mid-20th century French or French-style export piece. No maker's label, stamp or mark seen; back and underside not photographed, and there is no scale in the photos to check the stated size. Value is a judgement from the photos only, not price-checked.
condition: Good overall: ring marks, scratches and dull patches on the shelf top and lower shelf; mirror silvering looks clear; spindles and hooks look intact in the photos; edges rubbed.
rescore_note: Well made French provincial style oak hall stand with mirror, carved panels, forged hooks and lined drawer, sound apart from surface marks; decorative and oak per title but probably 20th century, and large brown furniture sells slowly. Judged upper end of $80 to $200 band. Not price-checked (search limit hit).
